surfaces.label: Command Deck
surfaces.nav: STORAGE → Command Deck (or menubar Deck / H)
operate: Open `/` (Command Deck) after the gateway is reachable.
Read the health chip on the rail (HEALTH_OK / DEGRADED / …) and live job/alert counts.
Use **New volume** to provision, or follow empty-state links (Create a volume →, Schedule nightly snapshots →, Create first bucket →).
Open a pool tile to drill into `/pools/:id`, or jump via Spotlight (⌘K / Ctrl+K).
Pause auto-refresh from the rail if you need a stable readout.
**Empty / fail:** No capacity → register a backend (INFRASTRUCTURE → Backends) and run discover; auth failures → paste JWT from the key icon.
**Success:** Sounding orb + pool/OSD lattice populate; jobs appear when you provision.

surfaces.label: Volumes
operate: Open `/volumes` and wait for the inventory table.
Click **Create volume** — pick name, size, policy/intent, tenant; submit starts a durable job.
Use **Refresh** / **Export CSV**; select rows for bulk delete when needed.
Open a row → SlideOver: Snapshot, Expand, Create schedule, or delete.
Watch **Jobs** (`/jobs`) until create/expand/snapshot succeed.
**Empty / fail:** No volumes → Create volume; empty after create → check Jobs and backend registration.
**Success:** Volume appears with state/size; mutations return `202` + job id.

surfaces.label: RBD Images
operate: Open `/rbd` and select the target pool (default often `rbd-nvme-prod`).
**Create image** with name + size; or Flatten / Clone / Resize / Snapshot from row actions.
Clone needs an existing snapshot — create under Snaps first if the hint says so.
Rollback is destructive — confirm before reverting to a snap.
**Empty / fail:** Wrong pool → switch pool; Ceph not ready → INFRASTRUCTURE → Ceph.
**Success:** Image listed in pool; jobs complete for flatten/clone/resize.

surfaces.label: Snapshots
operate: Open `/snapshots` to list PIT copies.
Create snaps from **Volumes** row → Snapshot (or schedule).
Clone or Restore from a snapshot row (confirm modal).
Bulk-delete selected snaps when retiring retention.
**Empty / fail:** No copies → open Volumes and snapshot a volume first.
**Success:** Snapshot row + clone/restore job succeeds.

surfaces.label: Schedules
operate: Open `/schedules`.
Click **Schedule** — choose volume, cadence, retention, snapshot vs backup.
Confirm the schedule row appears; verify later runs under Snapshots / Backups / Jobs.
**Empty / fail:** Need at least one volume and (for backups) a bucket.
**Success:** Schedule listed; first fire shows as a job.

surfaces.label: Backups
operate: Open `/backups`.
**Backup** — select volume + destination bucket; wait for the job.
Restore opens a modal (optional new volume name).
Bulk-delete selected backups when retiring.
**Empty / fail:** Create a bucket first under Buckets; ensure volume exists.
**Success:** Backup row with created time; restore job completes.

surfaces.label: Buckets
operate: Open `/buckets`.
**Create bucket** — name + backend/RGW target.
Open a bucket to list/upload objects when the panel is wired.
**Empty / fail:** No RGW → check Ceph/RGW on Backends/Ceph pages.
**Success:** Bucket listed; usable as Backup destination.

surfaces.label: Protection Status
operate: Open `/protection`.
Scan worst-case headline (healthy vs unprotected counts).
Drill volumes missing snaps/backups → Schedules or Backups.
**Empty / fail:** No volumes yet → provision first on Volumes.
**Success:** Every critical volume shows a healthy verdict.

surfaces.label: Observatory
operate: Open `/observatory` and wait for estate samples.
Use lenses / panels for pool and OSD pressure.
Jump **Command Deck** or **Alerts** from PageHead actions.
**Empty / fail:** No samples → Ceph metrics path cold; check `/metrics-dashboard` and gateway.
**Success:** Live estate picture matches Deck health.

surfaces.label: Activity
operate: Open `/activity`.
Scan recent events after provision/protect/migrate actions.
Correlate failures with Jobs and Audit.
**Empty / fail:** Quiet estate → trigger a volume op and refresh.
**Success:** Activity lines match your last mutations.

surfaces.label: Alerts
operate: Open `/alerts` (or rail bell → jump).
Filter by state; read critical vs open counts in PageHead.
**Silence** (1h) or **Resolve** with confirm.
**Empty / fail:** Filter too tight → clear filter; webhook paging may still need silence.
**Success:** Criticals cleared or deliberately silenced.

surfaces.label: Metrics
operate: Open `/metrics-dashboard`.
Confirm samples arrive; note OSD average % when shown.
Cross-check spikes with Observatory and Ceph.
**Empty / fail:** Waiting on samples → backend/Ceph metrics not streaming.
**Success:** Sample count > 0 and averages look sane.

surfaces.label: Jobs
operate: Open `/jobs` after any create/backup/migrate/DR action.
Select a job for created time, state, and error detail.
Use rail Jobs chip for running count without leaving the page.
**Empty / fail:** No jobs → you have not mutated yet; failed jobs → fix cause and retry from source page.
**Success:** Job reaches succeeded; inventory refreshes.

surfaces.label: Audit
operate: Open `/audit`.
Filter by actor and action.
Verify who created tokens, volumes, or DR failovers.
**Empty / fail:** No entries → auth/open mode may omit some events; confirm ATLAS auth mode.
**Success:** Expected mutations appear with actor + timestamp.

surfaces.label: Tenants
operate: Open `/tenants`.
Open a tenant → set Quota (Save) or review Policies slide-over.
Overrides fall back to built-in catalog when empty.
**Empty / fail:** No tenants → create via API/admin path your deploy uses; quotas block create if exceeded.
**Success:** Quota saved; volume creates respect limits.

surfaces.label: Access
operate: Open `/access`.
**Create user** with username/password; they sign in on the login page.
Delete users from the table when retiring access.
Paste service JWT via rail key icon for API automation.
**Empty / fail:** No users → create one; login fails → check ATLAS_AUTH_REQUIRED and token.
**Success:** New user can sign in; table lists accounts.

surfaces.label: Policies
operate: Open `/policies` and review intent names (`production`, `database`, …).
Use these intents in **Create volume**.
Tenant overrides live under Tenants → Policies.
**Empty / fail:** Catalog empty → gateway policy pack missing.
**Success:** Intents listed and selectable on create.

surfaces.label: Settings
operate: Open `/settings`.
Adjust Look & feel from the rail theme menu (Carbon, Nebula, …) if not on this page.
Confirm token/session via rail key icon.
**Empty / fail:** Changes not sticking → local storage blocked; re-auth.
**Success:** Theme/session match operator preference.

surfaces.label: API Docs
operate: Open `/api-docs`.
Scan Meta, Auth, Inventory, Write path (async jobs), Observability, DR, DataBridge.
Prefer `atlasctl` or REST with JWT; mutations return jobs.
**Empty / fail:** N/A — static reference; deep examples in product API docs.
**Success:** You can name the endpoint for the console action you just took.

surfaces.label: Cloud Databases
operate: Open `/databridge/sources`.
**Register** a source database (connection + engine).
Open a source → schema SlideOver (tables).
Then create a Migration Plan.
**Empty / fail:** Connection refused → network/creds; schema empty → privileges.
**Success:** Source listed with reachable schema.

surfaces.label: Migration Plans
operate: Open `/databridge/plans` after registering a source.
**Create** New migration plan → open Plan Detail.
Track stages and CDC from the detail page.
**Empty / fail:** No plans → register a Cloud Database first.
**Success:** Plan row links to `/databridge/plans/:id`.

surfaces.label: Plan Detail
operate: Open a plan from `/databridge/plans`.
Read engine/CDC badges; start or advance stages per UI.
**Stop CDC** / **Restart CDC** when streaming; use confirm for destructive cutover actions.
Jump to Validation / Replication / Edge clusters as needed.
**Empty / fail:** Stage blocked → fix source connectivity or prior stage job.
**Success:** CDC live / cutover complete per badges; Jobs clean.

surfaces.label: Edge DB Clusters
operate: Open `/databridge/edge-clusters`.
Provision from a migration plan when empty.
Confirm cluster health before cutover.
**Empty / fail:** No clusters → complete plan provisioning stage first.
**Success:** Cluster listed and healthy for the plan.

surfaces.label: Replication
operate: Open `/databridge/replication`.
Confirm streams match plans with CDC started.
Restart CDC from Plan Detail if a stream stalls.
**Empty / fail:** No streams → Start CDC on a plan.
**Success:** Stream lag/state acceptable for cutover.

surfaces.label: Validation
operate: Open `/databridge/validation` after plan stages that emit checks.
Open a run → per-table SlideOver.
Fix failures before cutover.
**Empty / fail:** No runs → trigger validation from Plan Detail / workflow.
**Success:** Tables pass; ready for cutover.

surfaces.label: Backends
operate: Open `/backends`.
Confirm at least one backend is registered and healthy.
Cordon/uncordon from Maintenance when draining.
**Empty / fail:** None registered → install driver/Ceph and discover (`atlasctl discover`).
**Success:** Backend row with capacity; Volumes can provision.

surfaces.label: Kubernetes
operate: Open `/kubernetes`.
Verify StorageClasses expected by CSI consumers.
**Empty / fail:** No classes → check KUBECONFIG / RBAC for the gateway.
**Success:** Classes listed for the cluster Atlas manages.

surfaces.label: Cluster
operate: Open `/cluster`.
Read primary name/health and pool/OSD counts.
Drill pools toward Ceph / Pool detail.
**Empty / fail:** Waiting on inventory → gateway↔Ceph connectivity.
**Success:** Health matches Command Deck rollup.

surfaces.label: Ceph
operate: Open `/ceph`.
Read rollup + df pools; jump to Cluster if needed.
Investigate degraded/rebuilding before big provisions.
**Empty / fail:** No ceph df → driver/credentials; use lab fake driver only for demos.
**Success:** HEALTH_OK (or understood warn) with pools listed.

surfaces.label: Pool Detail
operate: Open `/pools/:id` from a Deck or Cluster pool link.
Review fill, volume list, OSD lattice.
Jump to Volumes or Command Deck from actions.
**Empty / fail:** Pool not found → stale id; return to Deck.
**Success:** Pool metrics match Ceph df.

surfaces.label: Maintenance
operate: Open `/maintenance`.
Pause job engine only when you intend to quiesce (new jobs queue).
Cordon a backend to reject new provisioning.
Delete orphan backups carefully.
**Empty / fail:** Pause stuck → check API auth; cordon blocked → role.
**Success:** Desired pause/cordon state reflected; resume when done.

surfaces.label: Disaster Recovery
operate: Open `/dr` and read peers/mirrors + control-plane/dataplane readiness.
Add peer; enable mirroring on images; Promote / Demote / Failover with confirms.
Force promote only for split-brain recovery.
**Empty / fail:** Dataplane unverified → need second Ceph site; peers=0 → add peer first.
**Success:** Mirrors healthy; failover job succeeds when rehearsed.
